claims.claim: Codex has a native plugin architecture with a required .codex-plugin/plugin.json manifest, optional skills/, .app.json, .mcp.json, assets and lifecycle hooks; public plugins publish to a universal directory shared by ChatGPT and Codex; local and repo marketplaces also exist.
claims.label: VERIFIED_CURRENT_SELF_FETCHED

claims.claim: Codex supports lifecycle hooks. Confirmed events: SessionStart, SessionEnd, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, PostToolUse, PreCompact, PostCompact, UserPromptSubmit, Stop. Plugins may bundle hooks via a manifest hooks entry or default hooks/hooks.json.
claims.label: VERIFIED_CURRENT_SELF_FETCHED

claims.claim: Plugin-bundled hooks are NOT automatically trusted. Codex skips them until the user reviews and trusts the exact hook definition, and records trust against the hook's current hash, so changed hooks are re-marked for review and skipped until re-trusted.
claims.label: VERIFIED_CURRENT_SELF_FETCHED
claims.note: NOT in reviewer summary. Load-bearing for install UX and for the enforcement-boundary argument.

claims.claim: Hooks can be disabled entirely via [features] hooks = false, and allow_managed_hooks_only = true skips user, project, session and plugin hooks while keeping managed hooks. A --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust flag also exists.
claims.label: VERIFIED_CURRENT_SELF_FETCHED
claims.note: NOT in reviewer summary. Confirms hooks cannot be an enforcement boundary.

claims.claim: Specialized tool paths can opt out of the default hook path; hooks are a useful guardrail, not a complete enforcement boundary. PreToolUse may deny or rewrite supported local tool calls via updatedInput.
claims.label: VERIFIED_CURRENT_SELF_FETCHED

claims.claim: Plugin hook commands receive PLUGIN_ROOT and PLUGIN_DATA; Codex also sets CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA for compatibility with existing plugin hooks. SessionEnd hooks run synchronously with a default 1s and maximum 3s timeout. Model-visible hook output is limited to roughly 2500 tokens by default and spills to disk beyond that.
claims.label: VERIFIED_CURRENT_SELF_FETCHED
claims.note: NOT in reviewer summary. Constrains SessionEnd work and hook output budgets.
